cssVars: Input, label, matched and popup text

propDocs.Autocomplete.filter: Match suggestions by contains, startsWith or fuzzy search.
propDocs.Autocomplete.inlineComplete: Select the untyped suffix of the first matching suggestion.
propDocs.Autocomplete.autoHighlight: Highlight the first match while typing.
propDocs.Autocomplete.openOnFocus: Show recent recipes when the empty field gains focus.
propDocs.Autocomplete.loop: Wrap arrow navigation at the ends.
propDocs.Autocomplete.readOnly: Keep the input focusable while preventing edits.
propDocs.Autocomplete.required: Require a nonempty value in form submission.
propDocs.AutocompleteContent.side: Preferred popup side, subject to collisions.
propDocs.AutocompleteContent.align: Align the suggestions with the field.
propDocs.AutocompleteContent.sideOffset: Space from field to popup in pixels.
